text:
Extremely small pollen grains in water are viewed through a microscope. The grains are seen to
move continually and randomly.
What is the reason for this random movement?
A
The grains are moved by randomly moving water molecules.
B
The grains are moved by random convection currents in the water.
C
The grains are moved by random rays of light reflecting off them.
D
The grains are moved by the random motion of their own atoms.

options.label: A
options.text: The grains are moved by randomly moving water molecules.

options.label: B
options.text: The grains are moved by random convection currents in the water.

options.label: C
options.text: The grains are moved by random rays of light reflecting off them.

options.label: D
options.text: The grains are moved by the random motion of their own atoms.
